intro: Every photo below came off one of our own jobs — no stock, no catalogue shots. Most of them are the parts of a roof a homeowner never sees: the rotted decking under a roof that looked fine from the street, fresh sheathing going down before underlayment, a torch-down membrane being welded on a back-addition roof, the ridge of a finished architectural shingle job. That is deliberate. The finished roof is the easy picture. What is underneath it is what you are actually paying for.
